output_list.reason: The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When teamaccount == sender, it triggers an overflow of the balanceof[_from] -= _value; due to a large amount being transferred, and allows attackers to freeze participant's assets.

The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When executing mintedAmount += amount; totalSupply += amount; it can overflow the balanceIf target due to a large 'amount' value, allowing the owner to gain more tokens than intended.
